description.zh: 发版和开源前的安全体检：找出代码和配置里泄露的密钥、Token、密码，不该提交的 .env、私钥和凭证文件，以及拼接 SQL、eval、shell 注入、不安全反序列化、关闭证书校验等危险写法，按风险分级，给出修复方法、密钥作废和历史清理步骤。结果中的密钥一律打码。
description.en: Security check before release or open-sourcing: leaked keys, tokens and passwords, committed .env, private keys and credentials, plus risky patterns like concatenated SQL, eval, shell injection, unsafe deserialization and disabled TLS checks — graded, with fixes, key rotation and history cleanup. Secrets are always masked.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我要扫描的项目目录
welcome_message.en: Tell me which project folder to scan

prompt.zh: 扫描 ___ 目录，看看有没有泄露的密钥和危险写法。
prompt.en: Scan ___ for leaked secrets and risky code.

prompt.zh: ___ 准备开源，帮我做一遍发布前的安全检查。
prompt.en: We're open-sourcing ___. Run a pre-release security check.

prompt.zh: 我不小心把 ___ 的密钥提交到了仓库，现在该怎么办？
prompt.en: I committed a ___ key to the repo. What now?

prompt.zh: 这段代码有安全问题吗？怎么改：___
prompt.en: Is this code safe? How should I fix it: ___

prompt.zh: 帮我配置提交前自动扫描密钥。
prompt.en: Set up a pre-commit secret scan for me.

prompt.zh: 帮我检查并完善项目的 .gitignore，避免提交敏感文件。
prompt.en: Review and improve my .gitignore to keep sensitive files out.

zh: 每个工作日「18:00」扫描主仓库新增的高风险问题
每次发版前「15:00」执行完整安全扫描并导出报告
每周一「10:00」汇总未处理的中高风险问题
每月 1 日「10:00」提醒运行依赖漏洞检查（pip-audit / npm audit）
每季度第一天「10:00」提醒轮换长期使用的访问密钥
开源发布前一天「14:00」做一次全量敏感信息检查
en: Every workday at 18:00, scan the main repo for new high-risk issues
Before each release at 15:00, run a full scan and export the report
Every Monday at 10:00, summarize open medium and high issues
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, remind to run dependency audits
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, remind to rotate long-lived access keys
The day before open-sourcing at 14:00, run a full sensitive-data check
